npcs.name: Mountain Warden
npcs.description: A stoic figure in plain leathers stands watch on the high ridge, leaning on a gnarled staff. He wears no insignia, but his eyes have the same far-seeing weight as Old Wren's.
npcs.dialogueScript:
You climbed out of the gorge, then. Most don't.

The seals are old work, child. Not ours — the Wardens before us. We watch them as long as we can. The mine to the east has been... noisy lately. The Cavemother stirs.

Go if you must. Just remember: not every door down there is meant to be opened.
